blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Radiologists interpret computed tomography (CT) scans by jointly determining what a finding represents and where it lies in three-dimensional (3D) anatomy. However, CT models have treated CT interpretation and 3D segmentation as separate tasks, leaving textual findings spatially unverifiable and overlooking potential synergy between clinical understanding and spatial perception. Here we present HoloCT, a generalist 3D foundation model unifying CT interpretation and voxel-level segmentation by jointly modelling whole-volume context and fine-grained anatomical detail, providing 3D masks as evidence. We curated HoloDATA, comprising 195,921 CT scans from 73 public datasets and six clinical cohorts, with 6.2 million instruction dialogues and 2.8 million CT-mask pairs. Across 346 tasks spanning segmentation, lesion screening, visual question answering, and report generation on 61 internal and 12 external datasets, HoloCT outperformed specialist and foundation models. In multicentre validation across 11,455 clinical CT scans from five hospitals, HoloCT outperformed competing models in lesion segmentation and report generation by 18.2 and 15.3 points. It also achieved 85.1% mean accuracy in screening thyroid tumours and colon lesions, exceeding all four participating radiologists in a retrospective reader study. Further analyses revealed bidirectional semantic-spatial synergy: language-guided segmentation delineated unseen anatomical structures and lesions as well as diffuse free-text findings, outperforming the leading approach by 22.1 points, whereas prompting the model to generate corresponding 3D masks alongside its textual outputs significantly improved interpretation performance. HoloCT shows that clinical understanding and spatial perception can be learned together within a single foundation model and offers a path towards more accurate and reliable CT analysis.
blocks.zh: 放射学家通过共同确定一项发现在三维(3D)解剖学中代表什么和位于何处,来解释计算成的地形图扫描. 然而,CT模型将CT解释和3D分割作为单独的任务处理,使得文字结论在空间上无法验证,并忽略了临床理解和空间感知之间的潜在协同作用. 在此,我们介绍HoloCT,一个通用的3D基础模型,通过联合建模整卷上下文和精细的解剖细节,将CT解释和voxel级分解统一起来,提供3D口罩作为证据. 我们负责HoloDATA, 包括来自73个公共数据集和6个临床组群的195,921个CT扫描,有620万个指令对话,280万个CT-mask对. 在整个346项任务中,包括分解、病变筛查、视觉问题回答和61个内部数据集和12个外部数据集的报告生成,HoloCT的绩效超过了专家和基础模型。 在多中心验证5家医院的11 455个临床CT扫描中,HoloCT在损伤分解和报告生成中的表现超过竞争模型的18.2和15.3分. 它还在甲状腺肿瘤和结肠损伤筛查中实现了85.1%的精确度,超过了参加回溯性阅读器研究的四名放射学家。 进一步的分析揭示了双向语义-空间协同:语言指导分解在不见踪影的解剖结构和损伤以及散开的自由文字发现,比领先方法高22.1分,同时促使模型在文字输出的同时产生相应的3D口罩,大大改善了口译性能。 HoloCT显示,临床理解和空间感知可以在一个单一的基础模型中共同学习,并提供一个更准确可靠的CT分析路径.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Computed tomography (CT) provides rapid, high-resolution volumetric imaging for clinical screening, diagnosis, and treatment planning Smith-Bindman et al., 2019 .
When interpreting a scan, radiologists continuously link what a finding represents to where it lies in three-dimensional (3D) anatomy.
Reliable CT interpretation requires both: textual descriptions without anatomical localization are difficult to verify across hundreds of slices, and segmented regions without clinical characterization carry limited diagnostic meaning.

计算成型成像(CT)提供快速高分辨率的量子成像,用于临床筛选,诊断,和治疗规划 Smith-Bindman等, 2019.
在解释扫描时,放射学家不断将一个发现所代表的内容与三维(3D)解剖学中的位置联系起来.
可靠的CT解释既要求:没有解剖本地化的文字描述在上百个切片中难以被验证,而没有临床特征的分片区域具有有限的诊断意义.

blocks.en:
Existing deep learning systems have largely developed these two capabilities in isolation.
Segmentation networks delineate organs and abnormalities at the voxel level yet do not interpret their clinical significance Isensee et al., 2021 ; He et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2025b ; Rokuss et al., 2026 .
Conversely, CT vision–language models (VLMs) generate diagnostic text without providing voxel-level localization, making the anatomical basis of their predictions difficult to inspect Blankemeier et al., 2026 ; Hamamci et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2025 .
Recent grounded medical models connect language and segmentation at the output level Zhao et al., 2025a ; Zhou et al., 2026 ; Shen et al., 2026 ; Bai et al., 2024 ; Luo et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2026 ; however, for 3D scans, existing models route high-resolution spatial features only to the mask decoder rather than the language model, limiting the use of fine-grained spatial information during text generation Bai et al., 2024 ; Luo et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2026 .
Moreover, despite advances in voxel-level visual encoders Varma et al., 2026 , many of these models still rely on 2D slice encoders or coarsely downsampled 3D inputs at the expense of cross-slice continuity or fine spatial detail Wu et al., 2026 ; Bai et al., 2024 .
Whether clinical understanding and spatial perception can be learned jointly within a single foundation model and mutually reinforce one another therefore remains an open question.

blocks.en:
Here we introduce HoloCT, a generalist 3D foundation model that unifies CT interpretation and 3D segmentation by jointly modelling whole-volume context and fine-grained anatomical detail within a unified vision–language representation (Fig. 1 ).
Specifically, HoloCT couples a dual-scale visual encoding module, a unified multimodal large language model, and a mask decoder.
First, each scan is encoded through two parallel branches: a global encoder for whole-volume context and a detailed encoder that preserves fine-grained anatomical detail at standardized isotropic spacing.
Second, global tokens and fine-grained spatial tokens from the two encoders are supplied directly to the language model, enabling clinical reasoning to draw on fine-grained spatial features.
Third, segmentation tokens emitted by the language model guide the mask decoder for voxel-level delineation.
Accordingly, a single HoloCT model performs language-guided segmentation, lesion screening, visual question answering (VQA), and radiology report generation.
For grounded interpretation, HoloCT can pair its textual outputs with 3D masks of the corresponding anatomical regions or findings, providing spatial evidence that readers can inspect.

blocks.en:
To develop and evaluate HoloCT at scale, we curated HoloDATA by converting segmentation annotations, question–answer pairs, and radiology reports across datasets into a unified instruction–response format, with 3D masks incorporated where available.
HoloDATA comprises 195,921 CT scans totalling more than 61 million slices from 73 public datasets and six clinical cohorts at five hospitals, and contains 6.2 million instruction dialogues and 2.8 million CT–mask pairs across 246 anatomical structures and 50 lesion categories.

HoloDATA包含195,921个CT扫描,从73个公共数据集和5所医院的6个临床组群中共6,100万片以上,并包含620万个教学对话以及246个解剖结构和50个损伤类别的280万个CT-mask对。

blocks.en:
Evaluated on 346 tasks across 11 task formulations on 61 internal and 12 external datasets, a single HoloCT-8B model outperformed 82 dataset-specific nnU-Net models on internal segmentation benchmarks and surpassed segmentation foundation models in zero-shot external transfer across both seen and unseen categories of anatomical structures and lesions.
HoloCT also exceeded task-specific classifiers as well as medical and general-purpose VLMs in lesion screening, VQA, and report generation.
In multicentre clinical validation across 11,455 CT scans from six cohorts at five hospitals, HoloCT surpassed competing models in the segmentation of five lesion categories, including laryngeal lesions, lung cancer and thyroid tumours, as well as in zero-shot abdominal and chest CT report generation.
In retrospective reader studies of histopathology-confirmed thyroid tumours and colon lesions, HoloCT-8B achieved higher sensitivity and accuracy than all four participating radiologists, including two senior readers.

综合疾病控制系统还超越了特定任务分类器,以及病变筛查、VQA和报告生成中的医学和一般用途VLM。

在对组织病理学确认的甲状腺肿瘤和结肠损伤的追溯性读者研究中,HoloCT-8B的灵敏度和准确度都高于所有四名参与的放射学家,包括两名高级读者。

blocks.en:
Beyond benchmark performance, our analyses revealed bidirectional synergy between clinical understanding and spatial perception.
During training, adding text-only dialogues improved 3D segmentation accuracy, whereas incorporating mask-paired dialogues improved lesion screening, VQA, and report generation.
At inference, language-guided segmentation delineated previously unseen anatomical structures and lesions as well as diffuse free-text findings, outperforming the leading approach by 22.1 points; conversely, prompting HoloCT to generate corresponding 3D masks alongside its textual outputs significantly improved performance across these interpretation tasks while maintaining mask quality.
Together, these results demonstrate that unifying clinical understanding and spatial perception within a single foundation model strengthens both capabilities, aligning AI with how radiologists link diagnostic characterization to 3D anatomy when interpreting CT scans.

blocks.en: 2 Results
blocks.zh: 2 结果

blocks.en: 2.1 Overview of HoloCT and HoloDATA
blocks.zh: 2.1 全科全书和全科全书概览

blocks.en:
HoloCT is a generalist 3D foundation model developed and evaluated on the HoloDATA corpus to unify CT interpretation and voxel-level segmentation across volumetric CT tasks (Fig. 1 ).
HoloDATA comprises 195,921 volumetric CT scans with more than 61 million slices, integrating 184,466 scans from 73 public datasets with 11,455 scans from six clinical cohorts at five hospitals (Fig. 1 a).
Of the 73 public datasets, 61 internal datasets supported model development and held-out testing, whereas 12 external datasets were held out entirely for zero-shot and fine-tuned transfer.
By standardizing segmentation, question–answer, and radiology report annotations across datasets into a unified dialogue format with 3D masks without manual relabelling, HoloDATA provides 6.2 million instruction dialogues and 2.8 million CT–mask pairs from non-contrast and contrast-enhanced scans, covering 246 anatomical structures and 50 lesion categories across six major anatomical systems (Fig. 1 b).

HoloCT是一个通用的3D基础模型,在HoloDATA程序书上开发并评价,以统一CT解释和体积CT任务中的活分(图1).
HoloDATA包括195 921个体积 含6100多万片的CT扫描,从73个公共数据集整合出184,466个扫描,从5所医院的6个临床组群中整合出11,455个扫描(图1a.
在73个公共数据集中,61个内部数据集支持模型开发和停放测试,而12个外部数据集完全用于零镜头和微调传输。
HoloDATA将各数据集的分解、问答和放射学报告说明标准化,形成一个统一的对话格式,并配有3D口罩而无需人工重新贴上标签,因此,HoloDATA提供了620万个指令对话框和280万个来自非相干和对比性增强扫描的CT-mask对,覆盖了246个解剖结构和6个主要解剖系统的50个损伤类别(图1b)。

blocks.en:
Architecturally, HoloCT encodes each CT scan through two parallel branches (Fig. 1 c): a global encoder for whole-volume context and a detailed encoder that preserves fine-grained anatomical detail at standardized isotropic spacing.
Features from both encoders are projected into whole-volume global tokens and fine-grained spatial tokens and supplied directly to a unified multimodal large language model instantiated as HoloCT-4B and HoloCT-8B, integrating whole-volume and fine-grained features within a shared vision–language representation.
When spatial localization is requested, segmentation tokens emitted by the language model interact with multiscale skip features from the detailed encoder in a mask decoder, pairing diagnostic text with 3D masks.
blocks.zh:
建筑学上,HoloCT通过两个平行分支(图1c)对每次CT扫描进行编码:一个用于全卷上下文的全球编码器和一个详细编码器,在标准化同位素相距时保存精细的解剖细节.
两种编码器的特性都投射成全卷全球符号和精细的空间符号,并直接提供给一个统一的多模式大型语言模型即时化为HoloCT-4B和HoloCT-8B,将全卷和精细的特征综合到共同的视觉-语言代表中去.
当请求空间本地化时,由语言模型所发射的分解符会与由详细编码器中的多级跳过特性在口罩解码器中相互作用,将诊断文本与3D口罩对接.

blocks.en: 2.2 Evaluation settings
blocks.zh: 2.2 评价设置

blocks.en:
We evaluated HoloCT on 346 tasks spanning four task families and 11 formulations (Fig. 1 d): referring segmentation (target-level and finding-level), lesion screening (single-target and multi-target), VQA (closed-ended, open-ended and grounded) and report generation (narrative, structured, anatomy-grounded and finding-grounded).
Evaluations were organized into three tiers without scan overlap: held-out test splits of 61 internal public datasets, 12 external public datasets excluded from training, covering seen and unseen categories as well as VQA and report generation, and six clinical cohorts for lesion segmentation (centres 1–3), histopathology-confirmed lesion screening (centres 3 and 4) and report generation (centre 5).
More details can be found in Supplementary Tables 1 – 5 .

A single pretrained HoloCT model was evaluated without task-specific fine-tuning on all internal benchmarks and in zero-shot external and clinical evaluations.
For supervised comparisons in external lesion screening and segmentation, we additionally fine-tuned all unified models per task on the pooled training splits.

blocks.en:
HoloCT was compared with three families of state-of-the-art models: specialist networks trained per benchmark, including nnU-Net Isensee et al., 2021 for segmentation and 3D ResNet-18 He et al., 2016 for screening; segmentation foundation models VISTA3D He et al., 2025 , SAT-Pro Zhao et al., 2025b and VoxTell Rokuss et al., 2026 ; and vision–language models Qwen3-VL-32B Bai et al., 2025 , MedGemma 1.5-4B Sellergren et al., 2026 , RadFM-14B Wu et al., 2025 , HuluMed-32B Jiang et al., 2025 and M3D-Phi3-4B (M3D) Bai et al., 2024 . Details of these methods can be found in Supplementary Methods.
As few existing models support finding-grounded report generation, we additionally constructed a two-stage pipeline using HuluMed-32B and VoxTell for comparison.
For fair comparison, pretrained baselines were evaluated using released weights, whereas specialist and fine-tuned models used the corresponding training splits. In clinical screening, HoloCT was also compared with four radiologists in a blinded reader study.

blocks.en:
Segmentation was assessed using Dice and HD95 Taha and Hanbury, 2015 , with hit rates at Dice thresholds of 0.05 and 0.10 ( HIT 5 % \mathrm{HIT}_{5\%} and HIT 10 % \mathrm{HIT}_{10\%} ) for finding-level referring segmentation.
Screening was assessed using F1, sensitivity, specificity and accuracy, together with conditional Dice on true-positive detections; closed-ended VQA was assessed by accuracy, and grounded outputs additionally by match rate and Dice.
Free-text outputs were scored with lexical metrics (BLEU-4 Papineni et al., 2002 , ROUGE-L Lin, 2004 and METEOR Banerjee and Lavie, 2005 ) and clinical metrics (LlamaScore, evaluated using Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct Grattafiori et al., 2024 , plus RaTEScore Zhao et al., 2024 and GREEN Ostmeier et al., 2024 for reports).
Building on prior work emphasizing both linguistic and clinical measures of report quality Yu et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2025 , we summarized free-text quality using the Language–Clinical Score (LCS), the equal-weight mean of linguistic similarity and clinical agreement (Methods).

blocks.en: 2.3 Open-vocabulary 3D segmentation
blocks.zh: 2.3 开放式3D分区

blocks.en:
We first evaluated HoloCT’s foundational spatial perception through language-guided target-level referring segmentation across 272 internal and 51 external anatomical and lesion categories (Fig. 2 , Supplementary Table 8 ).
On the 128 internal categories supported by the segmentation foundation model VISTA3D, HoloCT-8B increased mean Dice from 0.837 to 0.870 ( P < 0.001 P<0.001 ; Fig. 2 a).
Across all 272 internal categories, a single HoloCT-8B model achieved a mean Dice of 0.816, outperforming the collection of 82 dedicated specialist nnU-Net models trained on individual datasets (0.799, P < 0.001 P<0.001 ; Fig. 2 b).
blocks.zh:

在由分块基础模型VISTA3D支持的128个内部类别上,HoloCT-8B将平均剂量从0.837增加到了0.870(P < 0.001 P<0.001;图2a)。
在所有272个内部类别中,一个单一的HoloCT-8B模型的平均值为0.816,超过了82个经过个人数据集培训的专门专家nnU-Net模型的收集工作(0.799,P < 0.001 P<0.001;图2b)。

blocks.en:
To assess zero-shot generalization beyond the training distribution, we next evaluated HoloCT without fine-tuning across 51 external categories comprising 37 seen and 14 unseen structures and lesions, where it consistently outperformed VISTA3D, SAT-Pro, M3D, and VoxTell (Fig. 2 c–f).
Specifically, on the 37 seen categories, HoloCT-8B reached a mean Dice of 0.658, surpassing specialist nnU-Net models by 0.339 (0.319, P < 0.001 P<0.001 ; Fig. 2 b) and the strongest text-prompted baseline, VoxTell, by 0.108 ( P < 0.001 P<0.001 ).
It led five of the six anatomical and lesion groups, with VoxTell slightly higher on vascular structures (0.436 compared with 0.423; Fig. 2 c,d).
On the 14 unseen categories, HoloCT-8B increased mean Dice over VoxTell from 0.340 to 0.414 ( P < 0.001 P<0.001 ) and led four of the five groups, with VISTA3D slightly higher on musculoskeletal bone lesions (0.165 compared with 0.154; Fig. 2 e,f).
In summary, a single HoloCT surpassed both specialist and foundation models on in-distribution benchmarks and demonstrated strong generalization performance to unseen anatomy and lesions.

blocks.en: 2.4 Single- and multi-target grounded clinical screening
blocks.zh: 2.4 单一和多目标临床筛查

blocks.en:
Beyond delineating known targets, clinical screening requires jointly determining whether an abnormality is present and localizing detected lesions on scans (Fig. 3 a).
We evaluated single-target screening against ResNet-18, nnU-Net, and M3D across internal testing, external zero-shot transfer, and external fine-tuning (Fig. 3 b,c), and multi-target screening against ResNet-18 and nnU-Net across internal testing and external fine-tuning (Fig. 3 d,e).
In single-target screening, HoloCT-8B achieved the highest macro F1 in all three settings: it exceeded nnU-Net by 19.4 percentage points internally (0.651 and 0.458, respectively) and, when fine-tuned as a single pooled model across external screening datasets, surpassed dedicated specialist nnU-Net models by 9.2 percentage points (0.859 compared with 0.767, P < 0.001 P<0.001 ; Fig. 3 b,c).
Across nine external lesion types evaluated without fine-tuning (three seen and six unseen), HoloCT-8B reached a macro F1 of 0.397, substantially outperforming text-prompted M3D (0.037) as well as ResNet-18 (0.050) and nnU-Net (0.036), which are restricted to predefined label sets (Fig. 3 c).
blocks.zh:
除了划定已知目标外,临床筛选还需要共同确定是否存在异常情况,并在扫描中确定所发现的损伤的位置(图3a)。
我们评价了对ResNet-18、nnU-Net和M3D的单一目标筛选,通过内部测试、外部零发转接和外部微调(图3b、c),并通过内部测试和外部微调(图3d、e)对ResNet-18和nnU-Net的多目标筛选。
在单一目标筛选中,HoloCT-8B在所有三种情况下都实现了最高的宏观F1:在内部超过nnU-Net19.4个百分点(分别为0.651和0.458),在通过外部筛选数据集作为单一集合模型进行微调时,超过了专门的NNU-Net模型9.2个百分点(0.859与0.767相比,P < 0.001 P < 0.001;图3 b,c)。
在未经微调评估的9个外伤类型(3个外观和6个外观)中,HoloCT-8B达到了0.397的宏F1,大大地超过了文字促发的M3D(0.037)以及ResNet-18(0.050)和nnU-Net(0.036),它们仅限于预定义的标签集(图3c)。

blocks.en:
To reflect clinical workflows in which multiple abnormalities are assessed simultaneously, we next evaluated multi-target screening by querying and segmenting multiple lesion types in a single pass without per-lesion prompting (Fig. 3 d).
HoloCT-8B raised macro F1 over nnU-Net from 0.368 to 0.718 internally and from 0.647 to 0.776 after external fine-tuning ( P < 0.001 P<0.001 ; Fig. 3 e).
On detected positive scans, HoloCT’s conditional Dice exceeded that of nnU-Net internally (0.679 compared with 0.337) and was lower after external fine-tuning (0.360 compared with 0.519), consistent with HoloCT returning positive masks on a larger and more difficult set of detected cases.
Across the 13 lesion types shared between single- and multi-target benchmarks, querying multiple targets jointly improved overall macro F1 over separate single-target queries for both HoloCT-8B (0.740 versus 0.727) and HoloCT-4B (0.729 versus 0.716; both P < 0.001 P<0.001 ), although single-target queries remained higher on the externally fine-tuned subset (Supplementary Tables 9 and 10 ).
By contrast, ResNet-18 and nnU-Net performed worse under multi-target prediction than with separate single-target models (Fig. 3 f).
blocks.zh:
为了反映同时评估多种异常的临床工作流程,我们下一次评价了多目标筛查,方法是在单个通行证中查询和分解多种损伤类型,而无需每分钟提示(图3d)。
HoloCT-8B在内部将宏F1高于nU-Net从0.368提高到了0.718,在外部微调后从0.647提高到了0.776(P < 0.001 P<0.001;图3e)。
在检测出阳性扫描后,HoloCT的有条件剂量超过了nnU-Net内部的剂量(0.679比0.337),在外部微调后更低(0.360比0.519),这与HoloCT在更大更困难的检测出病例中返回阳性口罩一致.
在单目标基准和多目标基准之间共有的13个病症类型中,通过对HoloCT-8B(0.740比0.727)和HoloCT-4B(0.729比0.716;P < 0.001 P<0.001)的单独单一目标查询,共同改进了总体宏观F1,尽管外部微调子集的单一目标查询仍然较高(补充表9和10)。
相比之下,ResNet-18和nnU-Net在多目标预测下的表现比单独单一目标模型(图3f)更差.

blocks.en:
To test whether generating 3D masks aided lesion-presence classification, we removed the grounding request from the prompt and retained only the question (Fig. 3 g).
Across 18 paired internal and external zero-shot lesion types, omitting mask generation reduced mean macro F1 from 0.562 to 0.505 for HoloCT-8B and from 0.531 to 0.504 for HoloCT-4B (both P < 0.001 P<0.001 ; Fig. 3 h).
Meanwhile, conditional Dice under grounded screening remained on par with standalone segmentation (Extended Data Fig. 1 a).
blocks.zh:
为了检验生成3D口罩是否有助于损伤-存在分类,我们取消了即时的打地请求,只保留了问题(图3克).
在18个对口的内外零发病型中,略去口罩的生成将HoloCT-8B的平均值F1从0.562降至0.505,而HoloCT-4B的平均值从0.531降至0.504(P < 0.001 P < 0.001;图3 h)。
同时,有条件 在有根据的筛选下进行的饮食仍然与独立的分类相同(扩展数据图1a)。

blocks.en: 2.5 Visual question answering and anatomy-grounded report generation
blocks.zh: 2.5 视觉问题回答和解剖分析生成报告

blocks.en:
In addition to clinical screening, we evaluated HoloCT’s broader clinical reasoning on closed-ended, open-ended, and grounded VQA, together with narrative, structured, and anatomy-grounded report generation (Fig. 4 ).
Across internal closed- and open-ended VQA benchmarks and external BIMCV-VQA de la Iglesia Vayá et al., 2020 , HoloCT outperformed competing general-purpose and medical VLMs (Fig. 4 a,e).
In closed-ended VQA for CT-RATE, HoloCT-8B achieved an accuracy of 93.4% (95% confidence interval (CI), 92.9%–94.0%) compared with 84.7% (95% CI, 83.9%–85.5%) for the strongest baseline, HuluMed-32B (Supplementary Table 11 ).
On external BIMCV-VQA, HoloCT-8B reached an LCS of 0.401, compared with 0.390 for HuluMed-32B (Supplementary Table 12 ).
In grounded VQA across AMOS-MM-VQA Ji et al., 2024 and DeepTumorVQA Chen et al., 2025 , generating supporting 3D masks alongside answers significantly improved mean accuracy from 75.9% to 77.1% for HoloCT-8B and from 68.0% to 76.0% for HoloCT-4B (both P < 0.001 P<0.001 ; Fig. 4 b–d); both models localized 94.0% of reference target objects at Dice levels comparable to standalone segmentation (Extended Data Fig. 1 a, Supplementary Tables 15 and 16 ).

除了临床筛选之外,我们还评估了HoloCT在封闭式、开放式和有底底的VQA的更广泛的临床推理,以及叙事式、结构化和解剖基础的报告生成(图4)。
2020年,通过内部封闭和开放式VQA基准和外部BIMCV-VQA de la Iglesia Vayá 等,HoloCT的成绩超过了相互竞争的通用和医学VLM(图4 a,e)。
在CT-RATE的封闭式VQA中,HoloCT-8B的精度为93.4%(95%的置信间隔(CI),92.9%-94.0%),而最强基线HuluMed-32B的精度为84.7%(95%-CI,83.9%-85.5%)(补充表11)。
在外部BIMCV-VQA上,HoloCT-8B的LCS达到0.401,而HuluMed-32B的LCS达到0.390 (补充表12.)
2024年在AMOS-MM-VQA Ji等人和DeepTumorVQA的禁地VQA Chen等人,2025年,生成辅助3D口罩和答案显著提高,HoloCT-8B的平均精度从75.9%提高到77.1%,HoloCT-4B的平均精度从68.0%提高到76.0%(P < 0.001 P < 0.001;图4b-d);两种模型的Dice级参考目标物体本地化率为94.0%,可与独立的分化相比(扩展数据图1a,补充表15和16)。

blocks.en:
Extending from targeted question answering to comprehensive scan interpretation, HoloCT also led all seven internal narrative and structured report-generation benchmarks as well as external BIMCV-RG (Fig. 4 f).
On RadGenome and external BIMCV-RG, HoloCT-8B achieved LCS values of 0.595 and 0.268, exceeding HuluMed-32B (0.487 and 0.256, respectively).
In anatomy-grounded report generation on RadGenome, both HoloCT-4B and HoloCT-8B matched all reference thoracic regions (100%) and raised report LCS to 0.600, outperforming text-only generation (0.587 and 0.595, respectively; both P < 0.001 P<0.001 ) and HuluMed-32B (0.487; Fig. 4 g, Supplementary Tables 17 and 18 ).
In qualitative comparisons, pairing regional descriptions with 3D anatomical masks corrected a left-sided mislocalization of middle-lobe atelectasis and recovered a sliding hiatal hernia and mild bone degeneration missed by text-only report generation (Fig. 4 h).

blocks.en: 2.6 Referring segmentation and finding-grounded report generation
blocks.zh: 2.6 参考分解和基于发现的报告生成

blocks.en:
Whereas anatomy-grounded reporting links text to predefined organs, clinical radiology reports describe diverse findings in free text, ranging from focal lesions such as pulmonary nodules or masses to diffuse, non-focal abnormalities such as bilateral ground-glass opacities (Fig. 5 a,b).
To evaluate fine-grained localization from clinical descriptions, we first benchmarked referring segmentation on ReXGroundingCT Baharoon et al., 2025 , where HoloCT-8B outperformed VoxTell and SAT-Pro across focal Dice, non-focal Dice, and spatial hit rates: overall mean Dice reached 0.291 (95% CI, 0.277–0.304), compared with 0.259 (95% CI, 0.240–0.274) for VoxTell and 0.168 (95% CI, 0.152–0.185) for SAT-Pro, and non-focal Dice reached 0.252 (95% CI, 0.224–0.277), compared with 0.149 (95% CI, 0.129–0.183) for VoxTell and 0.098 (95% CI, 0.081–0.124) for SAT-Pro (Fig. 5 c, Supplementary Table 19 ).
HoloCT thus localized both focal lesions and diffuse, non-focal chest CT findings more accurately than standalone text-prompted segmentation models from free-text clinical descriptions.
blocks.zh:
以解剖学为基础的报告将文本与预先界定的器官联系起来,而临床放射学报告则以自由文本描述不同的发现,从肺结核或质量等焦病到扩散、非焦病,如双边地镜不透明(图5a,b)。
为了从临床描述中评估精细的本地化,我们首先以2025年的ReXGroundingCT Baharoon et al.作为基准参照,在其中,HoloCT-8B在焦点滴滴滴滴滴滴滴滴滴滴滴滴滴滴滴滴滴滴滴滴滴滴滴滴滴滴滴滴滴滴滴滴滴滴滴滴滴滴滴滴滴分和SAT-Pro分泌分量超过分量。 剂量达到0.291(95%CI,0.277-0.304),而VoxTell为0.259(95%CI,0.240-0.274),SAT-Pro为0.168(95%CI,0.152-0.185),非焦化剂量为0.252(95%CI,0.224-0.277),而VoxTell为0.149(95%CI,0.129-0.183),而SAT-Pro为0.098(95%CI,0.081-0.124)(图5c,补充表19)。
因此,与从自由文本临床描述中得出的独立文本催化分解模型相比,全聚氯三联苯(HoloCT)对焦病症和扩散、非焦病胸腔CT检测结果进行了更准确的本地化。

blocks.en:
To unify free-text report generation with voxel-level finding localization, we next evaluated finding-grounded report generation, in which HoloCT autonomously identified abnormal findings across the chest CT scan and generated a dedicated 3D mask for each reported finding without pre-specified target prompts (Fig. 5 b).
Compared with a two-stage pipeline combining HuluMed-32B for report generation with VoxTell for post-hoc finding segmentation, HoloCT-8B raised finding-detection F1 from 0.239 (95% CI, 0.213–0.278) to 0.278 (95% CI, 0.248–0.314) and mean conditional Dice from 0.186 (95% CI, 0.165–0.213) to 0.234 (95% CI, 0.209–0.258; Fig. 5 d, Supplementary Table 20 ).
Removing the grounding request lowered all six linguistic and clinical report scores for HoloCT-8B (Fig. 5 e); in qualitative review, grounded generation detected and localized bilateral consolidation missed by text-only report generation (Fig. 5 f).
blocks.zh:
为了将自由文本报告生成与 voxel 级别查找本地化统一起来,我们接下来评价了基于查找的生成报告,其中HoloCT在胸口CT扫描中自主识别出异常发现,并为每个报告的发现生成了专用的3D口罩,没有预先指定的目标提示(图5b).
与HuluMed-32B用于报告生成和VoxTell用于hoc发现后分解的两相连接的管道相比,HoloCT-8B将F1的发现检测从0.239(95%CI,0.213–0.278)提高到0.278(95%CI,0.248–0.314),并将条件剂量从0.186(95%CI,0.165–0.213)提高到0.234(95%CI,0.209–0.258;图5d,补充表20)。
取消打地请求降低了HoloCT-8B的所有6个语言和临床报告分数(图5e);在质量审查中,发现只有文本报告生成所遗漏的有底代和本地化双边合并(图5f)。

blocks.en: 2.7 Multicentre clinical validation and reader study
blocks.zh: 2.7 多中心临床鉴定和读者研究

blocks.en:
Routine hospital CT workflows span diverse anatomical sites, scanner protocols, and contrast phases, requiring models that generalize across centres without per-cohort re-engineering.
To evaluate clinical applicability across real-world diagnostic settings, we tested HoloCT on 11,455 CT scans from six retrospective cohorts at five hospitals, covering lesion delineation across five targets—laryngeal lesions on contrast-enhanced CT (centre 1), lung cancer on non-contrast CT (centre 2), and benign, malignant and combined thyroid tumours on non-contrast CT (centre 3)—as well as clinical screening of histopathology-confirmed thyroid tumours (centre 3) and colon lesions (centre 4), and high-volume non-contrast chest and abdominal report generation (centre 5; Fig. 6 ).
In zero-shot segmentation across the five clinical lesion categories at centres 1–3, HoloCT-4B and HoloCT-8B substantially outperformed M3D, SAT-Pro, and VoxTell; HoloCT-8B increased mean Dice over VoxTell from 0.107 (95% CI, 0.066–0.150) to 0.488 (95% CI, 0.441–0.531) on laryngeal lesions and from 0.543 (95% CI, 0.506–0.579) to 0.715 (95% CI, 0.687–0.741) on lung cancer (Fig. 6 a, Supplementary Table 8 ).
Fine-tuned as a single model on the pooled training splits of all five clinical lesion categories, HoloCT-8B achieved a mean Dice of 0.696 compared with 0.681 across five dedicated specialist nnU-Net models, leading four of the five categories (Fig. 6 b).
Specifically, HoloCT-8B achieved a Dice of 0.684 (95% CI, 0.627–0.720) compared with 0.655 (95% CI, 0.602–0.707) on laryngeal lesions and 0.786 (95% CI, 0.762–0.809) compared with 0.776 (95% CI, 0.742–0.790) on lung cancer, while matching nnU-Net on combined thyroid tumours at 0.819 (95% CI, 0.774–0.864) compared with 0.819 (95% CI, 0.759–0.853). Averaged over the five clinical lesion categories and both evaluation settings (zero-shot versus VoxTell; fine-tuned versus nnU-Net), HoloCT-8B improved Dice by 18.2 points (Methods).
blocks.zh:
常规医院CT工作流程跨越不同的解剖站点,扫描仪协议和对比相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相
为了评估临床在现实世界诊断环境中的可适用性,我们在5所医院的6个追溯组进行了11 455个CT扫描测试,涵盖五个目标的损伤范围:对比增强CT(中心1)上的喉癌;非连续CT(中心2)上的肺癌;非连续CT(中心3)上的良性、恶性和合并甲状腺肿瘤;以及临床筛查组织病理学确诊甲状腺肿瘤(中心3)和结肠损伤(中心4),以及大量非连续胸膜和腹部报告生成(中心5;图6)。
在中心1-3、HoloCT-4B和HoloCT-8B的5个临床损伤类别的零发分解中,M3D、SAT-Pro和VoxTell的性能大大超过M3D;HoloCT-8B的平均剂量高于VoxTell从喉部损伤的0.107(95%CI、0.066-0.150)增加到0.488(95%CI、0.441-0.531),从肺部癌的0.543(95%CI、0.506-0.579)增加到0.715(95%CI、0.687-0.741) (图6a,补充表8)。
HoloCT-8B作为所有5个临床损伤类别集合培训分型的单一模式进行了微调,实现了平均剂量为0.696分,5个专用专家NNU-Net模型中的0.681分,领先5个类别中的4个(图6b)。
具体来说,HoloCT-8B实现了0.684(95%CI,0.627–0.720)的剂量,而咽喉损伤为0.655(95%CI,0.602–0.707),肺癌为0.786(95%CI,0.762–0.809),肺癌为0.776(95%CI,0.742–0.790),甲状腺肿瘤为0.819(95%CI,0.774–0.864),而NU-Net为0.819(95%CI,0.759–0.853)。 平均在5个临床损伤类别和两种评价环境(零镜头与VoxTell;微调与nnU-Net)中,HoloCT-8B改进了Dice18.2分(方法)。

blocks.en:
We next evaluated diagnostic performance in two clinical scenarios prone to missed findings in routine CT interpretation: thyroid tumours on non-contrast CT (centre 3), where subtle low-attenuation lesions within iodine-rich thyroid parenchyma are difficult to discern without ultrasound or intravenous contrast, and colon lesions on routine contrast-enhanced CT (centre 4), where focal wall thickening or intraluminal masses can mimic peristalsis or luminal contents.
A single HoloCT model was fine-tuned on the merged training splits of both histopathology-confirmed cohorts, pairing classification with 3D tumour segmentation for thyroid scans and text-only classification for colon scans, and evaluated on held-out cases in the matching task format ( n = 141 n=141 thyroid and n = 166 n=166 colon scans; Fig. 6 c,d, Extended Data Fig. 1 b).
In blinded reader studies against two junior and two senior radiologists per cohort, HoloCT-8B surpassed every reader in sensitivity and overall accuracy: on thyroid tumours, it achieved 81.6% accuracy (radiologists, 72.3%–78.0%), with 86.2% sensitivity (95% CI, 79.1%–92.4%), 65.6% specificity (95% CI, 50.0%–82.4%), and an F1 score of 0.879 (95% CI, 0.829–0.917; Supplementary Table 9 ); on colon lesions, it achieved 88.6% accuracy (radiologists, 75.3%–83.1%), with 92.6% sensitivity (95% CI, 86.9%–97.1%), 83.1% specificity (95% CI, 73.7%–90.7%), and an F1 score of 0.903 (95% CI, 0.853–0.939).
Compared case by case with the most accurate senior radiologist in each cohort, HoloCT-8B correctly identified 11 thyroid scans and 15 colon scans missed by the reader while misclassifying six scans per cohort that the reader judged correctly, increasing total correct diagnoses from 110 to 115 of 141 thyroid cases and from 138 to 147 of 166 colon cases (Fig. 6 d).
blocks.zh:
我们接下来评估了两种临床情况中的诊断性能,这两类情况容易在常规的CT解释中失去发现:非相突性CT(中心3)上出现甲状腺肿瘤,在没有超声波或静脉反射的情况下,碘富含甲状腺瘤内微妙的低强度损伤难以分辨出;在常规的对比增强CT(中心4)上发生结肠损伤,而焦壁加厚或腹腔内质可模仿穿透症或润滑物。
对一个单一的HoloCT模型进行了微调,将组织病理确认组群的合并训练分出,将甲状腺扫描的3D肿瘤分出分类与结肠扫描的文本只分出分类进行配对,并以匹配的任务格式(n=141n=141个甲状腺和n=166n=166个结肠扫描;fig. 6 c.d,扩展数据图 1 b)对被搁置的病例进行评价。
在针对每组两名初级和两名高级放射学家的盲读者研究中,HoloCT-8B在敏感度和总体准确度上超过了每个阅读者:关于甲状腺肿瘤,它取得了81.6%的精确度(放射学家,72.3%-78.0%),其敏感度为86.2%(95%CI,79.1%-92.4%),特殊度为65.6%(95%CI,50.0%-82.4%),F1分为0.879分(95%CI,0.829-0.917;补充表9);关于结肠损伤,它取得了88.6%的精确度(放射学家,75.3%-83.1%),敏感度为92.6%(95%CI,86.9-97.1%),特殊度为83.1%(95%CI,73.7-90.7%),F1分为0.903(95%CI,0.8530-939)。
HoloCT-8B将每一组中最准确的高级放射学家逐个案例加以比较,正确识别了读者误读了11个甲状腺扫描和15个结肠扫描,同时将读者正确判断的每组6个扫描错误分类,将141个甲状腺病例中的110个增加到115个,166个结肠病例中的138个增加到147个(图6d)。

blocks.en:
Finally, to assess automated report drafting across high-volume routine workloads without site-specific adaptation, we evaluated zero-shot anatomy-grounded report generation across 5,307 non-contrast abdominal and 2,974 non-contrast chest CT examinations from centre 5.
HoloCT-8B achieved LCS values of 0.443 (95% CI, 0.434–0.451) on abdominal CT and 0.384 (95% CI, 0.376–0.392) on chest CT, substantially outperforming HuluMed-32B at 0.236 (95% CI, 0.228–0.243) and 0.285 (95% CI, 0.275–0.296), respectively (Fig. 6 e).
In qualitative review, HoloCT captured subtle multi-organ abnormalities—including small pericardial effusion, reduced bone density with end-plate changes, and tiny thyroid calcifications—that HuluMed-32B omitted or misdescribed, while linking each regional statement to a verifiable 3D anatomical mask (Fig. 6 f).
blocks.zh:
最后,为了评估在不作特定地点调整的情况下对大量例行工作量进行自动报告起草工作,我们评价了5 307个非相干腹腔和2 974个非相干胸腔CT中心考试的零发解剖基础报告生成情况。
HoloCT-8B在腹部CT上达到LCS值为0.443(95%CI,0.434–0.451),胸口CT上达到0.384(95%CI,0.376–0.392),在0.236(95%CI,0.228–0.243)和0.285(95%CI,0.275–0.296)时,HuluMed-32B的性能分别大大超过0.236(图6e)。
在质量审查中,HoloCT捕捉到微妙的多器官异常——包括小心腹充血,随着末端板的变化而降低骨密度,以及小的甲状腺钙化——HuluMed-32B省略或误称了这些异常,同时将每个区域声明与可核查的3D解剖口罩(图6f)联系起来.

blocks.en: 2.8 Bidirectional synergy between clinical understanding and spatial perception
blocks.zh: 2.8 临床理解和空间感知之间的双向协同作用

blocks.en:
Having demonstrated strong performance across public benchmarks and clinical cohorts, we next investigated the underlying mechanism of semantic–spatial synergy during training by comparing six configurations varying task supervision and the integration of whole-volume and fine-grained spatial features (Fig. 7 a–c, Extended Data Fig. 1 c).
With only fine-grained tokens supplied to the language model, adding language supervision to segmentation-only training improved Dice from 0.601 to 0.613, whereas adding segmentation supervision to language-only training increased screening macro F1 from 0.256 to 0.351, alongside gains in VQA and report generation (Fig. 7 c).
Adding the global encoder further improved all four task families, while directly supplying both whole-volume and fine-grained tokens to the language model outperformed separate pathways and early token fusion (Fig. 7 b,c).
blocks.zh:
在展示出各种公共基准和临床群的强效表现之后,我们接下来通过比较六种不同任务监督的配置以及全容量和精细地纹空间特征的整合(图7 a-c,扩展数据图1 c),调查了培训期间语义-空间协同的基本机制。
由于只向语言模型提供精细纹章,将语言监督添加到只分化培训中,使Dice从0.601被改进为0.613,而将分化监督添加到只语言培训中则将筛选宏F1从0.256被提高至0.351,同时在VQA和报告生成方面有所收获(图7c).
添加全球编码器进一步改善了所有四个任务家族,同时直接为语言模型提供全容量和精细的代币,其性能超过了单独的路径和早期代币融合(图7b,c).

blocks.en:
To further determine at inference whether clinical interpretation relied directly on fine-grained 3D spatial features, we masked language-model attention to fine-grained tokens in HoloCT-8B while leaving skip connections from the detailed encoder to the mask decoder intact (Fig. 7 d).
Blocking this attention significantly degraded performance across all four tasks ( P < 0.001 P<0.001 ; Fig. 7 e): segmentation Dice fell from 0.840 to 0.811, screening macro F1 dropped from 0.678 to 0.061, VQA accuracy declined from 77.1% to 70.9%, and report LCS decreased from 0.507 to 0.429.
Crossing spatial-token masking with retention or removal of the grounding request further showed a significant interaction ( P < 0.001 P<0.001 ; Fig. 7 f,g): masking fine-grained tokens reduced the gain from mask generation from 1.47 to 0.53 percentage points in screening F1, from 1.24 to 1.06 percentage points in VQA accuracy, and from 1.19 to 0.24 points in report LCS (0–100 scale). These results indicate that grounded interpretation depends on the fine-grained spatial tokens shared with segmentation, although masking constitutes an out-of-distribution intervention.
blocks.zh:
为了进一步推断临床解释是否直接依赖于精细的3D空间特征,我们掩盖了语言模型对HoloCT-8B中精细的精细道具的关注,同时将从详细编码器到口罩解码器的连接跳过(图7d.
在所有四项任务(P < 0.001 P < 0.001;图7e)中,将注意力堵住,其性能明显退化: 滴滴从0.840降至0.811,筛选宏F1从0.678降至0.061,VQA精度从77.1%降至70.9%,报告LCS从0.507降至0.429.
用保留或去除地基请求来跨出空间托接口罩,进一步显示出了显著的相互作用(P < 0.001 P < 0.001;图7 f,g):蒙接口罩使口罩产生的收益从筛选F1时的1.47个百分点降至0.53个百分点,从VQA精确度的1.24个百分点降至1.06个百分点,从报告LCS(0-100比例尺)的1.19个百分点降至0.24个百分点. 这些结果表明,有根据的解释取决于与分化共享的精细的空间标志,尽管遮掩构成分配外干预.

blocks.en: 3 Discussion
blocks.zh: 3 讨论情况

blocks.en:
HoloCT integrates whole-volume and fine-grained 3D features within a unified multimodal large language model, uniting CT interpretation and voxel-level segmentation across tasks largely addressed separately by segmentation models Isensee et al., 2021 ; He et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2025b ; Rokuss et al., 2026 and medical VLMs Blankemeier et al., 2026 ; Hamamci et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2025 , or connected only at the decoder output level Bai et al., 2024 ; Luo et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2026 .
Built upon the large-scale HoloDATA corpus, HoloCT outperformed specialist and foundation segmentation models, task-specific classifiers, and VLMs across 346 benchmark tasks and six clinical cohorts at five hospitals.

blocks.en:
A central finding of this work is the bidirectional synergy between clinical understanding and 3D spatial perception in volumetric CT.
Prior studies on 2D radiographs aligned report text with global and local image features Huang et al., 2021 ; Tiu et al., 2022 ; Zhang et al., 2023 , and recent medical visual tokenizers encode anatomy and semantics within unified representations Ma et al., 2025 ; Ma et al., 2026 .
Extending this joint representation design to volumetric CT, HoloCT supplies whole-volume global tokens and fine-grained spatial tokens directly to a unified language–segmentation model.
During training, adding text-only dialogues improved 3D segmentation accuracy, whereas incorporating mask-paired dialogues improved lesion screening, VQA, and radiology report generation.
At inference, this synergy operated in both directions: semantic representations enabled language-guided segmentation to generalize zero-shot to unseen anatomy, novel lesion categories, and diffuse free-text findings, while retaining the grounding request to generate 3D masks alongside text significantly improved screening, VQA, and report generation without compromising mask quality.
Crucially, masking language-model attention to fine-grained spatial tokens markedly attenuated the gains from mask generation, indicating that grounded clinical reasoning draws directly on the fine-grained spatial features shared with voxel-level segmentation.
Moreover, although HoloCT-8B achieved stronger overall performance, explicit grounding requests in VQA and report generation yielded larger gains for HoloCT-4B, suggesting that larger models may partially internalize spatial–semantic alignment, whereas smaller models benefit more from explicit spatial grounding during clinical interpretation.
blocks.zh:
这项工作的一个中心发现是临床理解与体积CT中3D空间感知之间的双向协同.
以往关于2D射线图与全球和地方图像特征一致的报告文本的研究 黄等,. 2021; Tiu等, 2022; Zhang等, 2023; 和近代医学视觉活化剂在统一代表马等范围内编码解剖学和语义学, 2025; Ma等, 2026.
将这种联合代表设计扩展至音量CT,HoloCT直接将全音量的全球代号以及精细的空间代号提供给一个统一的语言-分区模型。
在培训期间,只增加文字对话提高了3D分解的准确性,而纳入口罩对话则改善了病情筛查、VQA和放射学报告生成。
推论,这种协同效应在两个方向上运作:语义表达使语言指导分解能够将零镜头概括到看不见的解剖学,新颖的损伤类别,以及散开的自由文本发现,同时保留了在文字显著改进的筛选的同时生成3D口罩的打地请求,VQA,以及报告生成而不损害口罩质量.
关键是,遮掩语言模型对细纹空间标志的注意,明显地削弱了从口罩生成中获得的收益,表明基于临床推理直接取自与花瓶分层共有的细纹空间特征.
此外,尽管HoloCT-8B取得了更强的整体性能,但是在VQA和生成报告方面的明确定位请求为HoloCT-4B带来了更大的收益,这表明更大的模型可以部分地将空间-语义相接内化,而较小的模型则在临床解释期间从明确的空间定位中受益更大。

blocks.en:
Beyond single-task performance, unifying semantic reasoning and segmentation consolidates multi-step clinical workflows within a single model Moor et al., 2023 .
Whereas interactive and text-prompted segmentation models require users to specify each target in advance Ma et al., 2024 , HoloCT screened multiple candidate lesions in a single pass, improving overall detection accuracy over separate single-target queries while producing verifiable 3D masks.
In addition, in finding-grounded report generation, HoloCT detected and localized chest CT abnormalities simultaneously, outperforming a two-stage pipeline combining HuluMed-32B and VoxTell.
blocks.zh:
除了单任务性能外,统一语义推理和分化还整合了单模型Moor等2023年的多步骤临床工作流程.
互动和文字催化分解模式要求用户事先指定每个目标,Ma等人,2024年,HoloCT用一个通行证筛选了多个候选损伤,提高了单个目标查询的总体检测精度,同时产生了可核查的3D口罩.
此外,在基于发现的报告生成中,HoloCT同时检测出并本地化了胸腔CT异常,超过了HuluMed-32B和VoxTell结合的双相管.

blocks.en:
In clinical practice, pairing diagnostic text with voxel-level masks directly addresses the verifiability bottleneck of medical VLMs.
Although recent VLMs achieve strong aggregate scores in report generation Zambrano Chaves et al., 2025 , fine-grained perceptual errors and anatomical mislocalizations often remain hidden in free text D’Cunha et al., 2026 and are labour-intensive to audit across CT volumes spanning hundreds of slices.
Whereas concept-based explanations support auditing only at the whole-image level Kim et al., 2024 ; Nie et al., 2026 , grounding classifications, question answers, and report statements with 3D masks allows clinicians to inspect the volumetric evidence underlying each textual output.
Alongside spatial verifiability, multicentre clinical validation demonstrated strong real-world applicability: HoloCT-8B surpassed human radiologists in sensitivity and overall accuracy on histopathology-confirmed thyroid tumours and colon lesions and generalized zero-shot to high-volume chest and abdominal report generation, highlighting its potential for subtle-lesion triage and automated report drafting.
blocks.zh:
在临床实践中,将诊断文本与活塞级口罩相配直接解决了医学VLM的可核查瓶颈.
虽然最近的VLM在2025年的报告生成人赞布拉诺·查维斯等人(Zambrano Chaves et al., 2025)中取得了强大的总分,但精细的感知错误和解剖错误往往仍然被隐藏在2026年的自由文本D-Cunha et al. 中,并且对跨越上百个切片的CT卷进行了劳动密集型审计.
基于概念的解释只支持全图像一级的审计 Kim等人, (美国) 2024; Nie等, 2026., 基础分类,问答,以及带有3D口罩的报告声明,使临床医生能够检查每个文字输出所基于的体积证据.
除了空间可核查性外,多中心临床验证也显示出了强大的现实世界适用性: HoloCT-8B对组织病理学确认的甲状腺肿瘤和结肠损伤的敏感性和总体准确性以及大容量胸腔和腹部报告的生成普遍为零射出,超过了人类放射学家,突出了其细微分泌和自动起草报告的潜力。

blocks.en:
Several dataset and modelling limitations warrant future investigation.
First, although HoloDATA spans six major anatomical systems for segmentation, grounded report generation remains concentrated in thoracic and abdominal CT, with finding-level 3D masks currently limited to chest CT; extending fine-grained finding annotations to abdominal, head-and-neck, neuroimaging, and musculoskeletal CT will broaden grounded reporting.
Second, despite substantial gains over existing foundation models, segmentation accuracy on musculoskeletal bone lesions and diffuse, non-focal chest findings remains limited; adaptive high-resolution cropping and iterative mask refinement may further improve delineation of these challenging targets.
Third, HoloCT currently interprets single CT volumes independently, whereas routine radiological workflows rely on longitudinal comparisons with prior scans, multi-phase contrast studies, and integration with electronic health records or complementary modalities such as MRI and PET–CT; extending the unified architecture to these longitudinal and multimodal settings is an important next step.
blocks.zh:
若干数据集和建模限制值得今后进行调查。
首先,尽管HoloDATA跨越了六大解剖系统进行分解,但有根据的报告生成仍然集中在胸腔和腹腔CT,发现级的3D口罩目前仅限于胸腔CT;将有细纹的发现说明扩大到腹腔、头颈、神经成像和肌肉骨骼CT将扩大有根据的报告范围。
第二,尽管在现有基础模型上取得了很大进展,但肌肉骨骼损伤和扩散的分化精度仍然有限;适应性高分辨率收割和迭代口罩的改进可进一步改善这些有挑战性目标的划定。
第三场,你好 CT目前独立地解释单个CT卷,而常规的放射性工作流程则依赖于与之前的扫描,多相对比研究的纵向比较,以及与电子健康记录或MRI和PET-CT等互补模式的整合;将统一的架构扩展到这些纵向和多模式设置是下一步的重要一步.

blocks.en:
From a clinical translation perspective, our hospital evaluation was retrospective and conducted within a single country, motivating prospective validation across international cohorts and diverse scanner protocols.
Further reader-in-the-loop trials are needed to quantify how interactive 3D mask verification affects diagnostic accuracy, reading efficiency, and clinician trust in routine workflows Tanno et al., 2025 ; Yu et al., 2024 .
Finally, safe clinical deployment will require calibrated uncertainty estimation and automated quality control alongside expert radiological oversight.
blocks.zh:
从临床翻译的角度来看,我们的医院评估是追溯性的,在一个单一国家内进行,激发了跨国际群体和各种扫描仪协议的预期验证。
需要进一步的即时阅读器试验,以量化交互式3D口罩核查如何影响诊断准确性、阅读效率和临床医生对日常工作流程的信任 Tanno等,2025;Yu等,2024年.
最后,安全的临床部署将需要经过校准的不确定性估计和自动化的质量控制以及专家的放射监督。

blocks.en: In conclusion, HoloCT demonstrates that clinical understanding and 3D spatial perception can be learned synergistically within a single generalist foundation model, offering a unified path towards more accurate, generalizable, and spatially verifiable CT interpretation.

blocks.en:
HoloDATA was assembled from 73 public datasets, including 62 segmentation datasets and 11 with language annotations, alongside six clinical cohorts from five hospitals.
Dataset sources, annotations and data splits are listed in Supplementary Tables 1 – 5 .
Predefined splits were retained; for public datasets without predefined splits, 20% of scans were randomly held out for testing.
For entries marked as aligned, scans shared across datasets and their associated annotations were assigned to the same split. We verified that none of the 12 external datasets, the clinical cohorts or the internal test scans were included in the training data of VISTA3D or Med3DVLM, according to their published data descriptions. The 6.2 million instruction dialogues were counted as single-turn dialogues, with each turn of a multi-turn dialogue counted separately.
The 2.8 million 3D segmentation masks were counted as unique CT–mask pairs, excluding repeated uses of the same mask across tasks.

blocks.en:

Single-target and multi-target lesion screening required presence-or-absence decisions and masks for positive targets.
Missing annotations were not treated as negative labels.
Closed-ended VQA required binary or multiple-choice answers, whereas open-ended VQA required free-text answers.
Grounded VQA paired closed-ended answers with supporting segmentation masks.
Reference reports comprised findings or impressions for narrative report generation and region-specific findings for structured report generation.
Each dataset’s original reporting format was preserved.
Anatomy-grounded report generation paired regional descriptions with anatomical masks, whereas finding-grounded report generation paired individual findings with their corresponding masks.

blocks.en:
Training comprised three stages: vision–language alignment (Stage 1), multitask pre-training (Stage 2) and high-quality multitask tuning (Stage 3) (Supplementary Table 6 ).
The encoders and language backbone were initialized from their pretrained weights.
Stage 1 trained only the global and detailed projectors on approximately 0.68 million report-generation samples.

编码器和语言主干器从其预先训练的重量上初始化.
第一阶段只对全球和详细的投影员进行了约68万个报告生成样本的培训。

blocks.en:
Stage 2 used approximately 2.70 million language-supervised and 3.50 million segmentation-supervised samples, including single-region report-generation samples in which each region of a structured report formed a separate sample.
The language backbone was trained with low-rank adaptation (LoRA) Hu et al., 2022 , and all other modules were fully trainable.
Stage 3 used approximately 1.69 million language-supervised and 1.15 million segmentation-supervised samples with the same trainable modules.
Stage 3 excluded single-region report-generation samples, so that all report-generation tasks used complete reports rather than individual regional descriptions.
Stage 3 excluded RadGenome VQA, because of its limited question diversity and disproportionate sample size, and PASTA-Gen-TotalSeg, because of its low-quality TotalSegmentator pseudo-labels.
In Stages 2 and 3, segmentation-supervised and language-supervised updates alternated.

blocks.en:
All ablations used HoloCT-8B.
Training ablations S1–S6 were initialized from the same pretrained weights as Stage 1 and trained for five epochs with Stage 3 settings on a random 10% of Stage 3 data plus the training splits of the ablation benchmarks.
S1–S3 supplied only fine-grained tokens to the language model and differed in supervision: S1 used language supervision, S2 used segmentation supervision with text and mask losses, and S3 combined both.
S4–S6 combined both forms of supervision and differed in how whole-volume and fine-grained tokens were integrated.
S4 supplied only whole-volume tokens to the language model and used fine-grained features solely for mask decoding.
S5 fused projected whole-volume and fine-grained tokens before the language model using two-way attention inspired by the Segment Anything Model (SAM) Kirillov et al., 2023 , supplying the updated whole-volume tokens to the language model and passing the updated fine-grained tokens to the mask decoder.
S6 supplied both token sets directly to the language model and corresponded to the HoloCT architecture.
Inference ablations evaluated a single HoloCT-8B checkpoint on the training-ablation benchmarks in a 2 × 2 2\times 2 design: fine-grained tokens were either visible or masked in causal attention, and grounding requests were either retained in or removed from the prompts.
Masking preserved the position indices of fine-grained tokens, and the mask decoder still received fine-grained features.
Initialization of the remaining modules, ablation architectures and benchmarks are detailed in Supplementary Methods, and results are shown in Fig. 7 .

blocks.en: 4.6 Clinical evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.6 临床评价

blocks.en:
Clinical evaluation used six retrospective cohorts from five centres, with one CT scan per patient.
The research ethics committees of all five participating centres (Zhongshan Hospital, Fudan University; the First Affiliated Hospital, Zhejiang University School of Medicine; Sir Run Run Shaw Hospital, Zhejiang University School of Medicine; the Affiliated Yangming Hospital of Ningbo University; and Guizhou Provincial People’s Hospital) approved the study and waived informed consent; images and records were de-identified.
Sample sizes were determined by the number of eligible cases, without an a priori power calculation.
Scans from centres 1 and 4 were contrast-enhanced, and the remaining scans were non-contrast.
Centres 1 and 2 included only lesion-positive cases, whereas centres 3 and 4 included both positive and negative cases.
Four physicians delineated lesion masks for centres 1–3 using clinical and pathological findings.
Histopathology provided reference diagnoses for thyroid (centre 3) and colon (centre 4) lesion screening; colon cases had no reference masks.
The cohort design is shown in Fig. 1 a.

所有5个参与中心(佛丹大学中山医院;浙江大学医学院第一附属医院;浙江大学医学院跑跑活肖爵士医院;宁波大学阳明附属医院;贵州省人民医院)的研究伦理委员会批准了该研究,并免除了知情同意;图像和记录被去鉴定.
样本规模由合格案例数量决定,不进行先验功率计算.
中心1和4的扫描进行了对比增强,其余的扫描是非相容的.
中心1和2只包括阴道阳性病例,而中心3和4包括阳性和阴性病例。
4名医生利用临床和病理诊断结果为1至3号中心划定了外伤口罩。
组织病理学为甲状腺(中心3)和结肠(中心4)的损伤筛查提供了参考诊断;结肠病例没有参考口罩。

blocks.en:
Lesion segmentation was evaluated at centres 1–3, and lesion screening at centres 3 and 4.
Each cohort was split at the patient level into 80% training and 20% testing.
Models were evaluated zero-shot and after fine-tuning on the training split, using the same test patients.
Two junior radiologists (3 and 5 years of experience) and two senior radiologists (13 and 17 years of experience) independently reviewed the original CT volumes of the test patients in shuffled order, without access to reference diagnoses or model outputs.
Screening performance of models and readers was measured by F1, sensitivity, specificity and accuracy.
Diagnostic correctness of each model was compared with that of the highest-accuracy senior reader in each cohort.
Reader comparisons are shown in Fig. 6 c,d.

blocks.en:
Confidence intervals were estimated from 1,000 percentile bootstrap resamples of CT scans within datasets (seed 42), keeping all observations from each scan together.
Paired conditions used identical resamples, and all aggregation steps were repeated for each resample.
The 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles defined 95% confidence intervals.

Paired条件使用相同的复标,每次复标时都会重复所有汇总步骤.
2.5和97.5百分位数定义了95%的置信间隔.

blocks.en:
All hypothesis tests were two-sided, and P P values were not adjusted for multiple comparisons.
Segmentation comparisons used paired t t -tests of target-level scores s ¯ ℓ \bar{s}_{\ell} .
Screening, VQA and report comparisons, including model–reader comparisons, used paired permutation tests with 10,000 permutations, in which the two conditions’ complete predictions for each CT scan were exchanged with probability 0.5 before the metric was recomputed.
Score drops after grounding-request removal were compared between intact and masked attention using paired t t -tests, with pairing by target for screening and by CT scan for VQA and report generation.

所有假想测试都是双面的,P值没有被调整以进行多重比较.

筛选、VQA和报告比较,包括模型-阅读器比较,用一万个通量的配对通量测试,其中在重算度数之前,用概率为0.5交换对每次CT扫描的两个条件的完整预测。
地面请求清除后的分数下降通过对t t 测试和对VQA和报告生成的CT扫描进行对比。

blocks.en: Abstract summary values for HoloCT-8B were computed as follows. (1) The 18.2-point clinical segmentation improvement is the macro average over the five clinical lesion categories of, per category, the equally weighted mean of two Dice differences: zero-shot HoloCT-8B minus zero-shot VoxTell, and fine-tuned HoloCT-8B minus specialist nnU-Net. (2) The 15.3-point report-generation improvement is the equally weighted mean, over the abdominal and chest cohorts of centre 5, of the LCS difference between grounded HoloCT-8B and HuluMed-32B. (3) The 85.1% screening accuracy is the equally weighted mean of per-cohort accuracies (115/141 thyroid; 147/166 colon). (4) The 22.1-point open-vocabulary margin is the difference in macro Dice between HoloCT-8B and VoxTell over 16 equally weighted items: 10 external unseen targets (PANORAMA targets were excluded because they were used in VoxTell training), the five clinical categories evaluated zero-shot, and overall finding-level Dice on ReXGroundingCT.

(2) 15.3点报告的生成改进是,在LCS与HuluMed-32B之间的LOCS差值中,对中心5腹部和胸部组的等加权平均值。 (3)85.1%的筛选精度是每科增量的加权平均值(115/141甲状腺;147/166克郎)。 (4)22.1分的开口-省分比值是HoloCT-8B和VoxTell超过16个等量加权项目在宏观分量上的差异:10个外不可见目标(PANORAMA目标被排除在外,因为用于VoxTell培训),5个临床类别评价为零发,以及REXGroundingCT上的总体发现分量.

blocks.en: 4.8 Computational hardware and software
blocks.zh: 4.8 计算硬件和软件

blocks.en:
All models were trained on NVIDIA H100 GPUs.
HoloCT-4B and HoloCT-8B each used 16 GPUs across two nodes.
nnU-Net and 3D ResNet-18 each used two GPUs, whereas M3D, HuluMed-32B and SAT-Pro each used eight.
HoloCT training used gradient checkpointing and DeepSpeed ZeRO-3, with optimizer states offloaded to CPU memory Rajbhandari et al., 2020 .
Training required approximately 3,500 GPU hours for HoloCT-4B and 4,500 GPU hours for HoloCT-8B.
blocks.zh:
所有型号都接受了NVIDIA H100 GPU的培训.
HoloCT-4B和HoloCT-8B各使用横跨两个节点的16个GPU.
nnU-Net和3D ResNet-18各使用两个GPU,而M3D,HuluMed-32B和SAT-Pro各使用八个.
HoloCT训练使用梯度检查和DeepSpeed ZeRO-3,优化状态卸入CPU内存 Rajbhandari等,2020.
HoloCT-4B的培训需要约3 500个GPU小时,HoloCT-8B的培训需要约4 500个GPU小时。

Here, aligned means that a dataset follows the target dataset’s split to prevent label leakage. Masks equal the number of positive CTs for mask-annotated labels; Private04 has classification labels only and no masks. Positive and Negative are full-cohort label-specific counts; NR denotes not reported. The Private04 held-out test set contains 166 CTs (95 positive, 71 negative); these test counts are not full-cohort counts. Total CTs count each listed dataset once across its labels; overlapping dataset variants are not deduplicated.
